title: Curves with a large automorphism group admitting a cyclic subgroup of index $2$
summary: The Hurwitz bound on the order of the $\mathbb K$-automorphism group ${\rm{Aut}}({\mathcal{X}})$ of an algebraic curve ${\mathcal{X}}$ of genus $g(\mathcal{X})\ge 2$ defined over a field $\mathbb K$ of zero characteristic states that $|{\rm{Aut}}({\mathcal{X}})|\le 84(g(\mathcal{X})-1)$. Improved bounds are available for the order of certain types of subgroups within automorphism groups. For instance, if a subgroup $H$ of ${\rm{Aut}}({\mathcal{X}})$ is dihedral, then in the complex case, $|H| \leq 4g(\mathcal{X}) + 4$.
